envelope.author: nico
envelope.reason: the design had no sign for the unit of design a unit is built to achieve, and shards written with mechanism in them destabilized every plan
envelope.cause: regrounding with the operator, 2026-09-29 (conceptual-design.md and the thread after it)

payload.gloss: a concept of the design as the architect hands it down to be realized, together with everything it stands on: it states what must hold and why, never how a harness or a codebase achieves it, so a quirk met while building it is the planner's and the implementer's to solve, not a reason to change it. The architect cuts the design into shards; a plan realizes a set of them, and each of its units realizes exactly one.
